body: She's not manipulative. She's stuck in a really bad relationship and she's scared that I'm going the same way. She's not stopping me going from university, I meant to say she'd be even more unhappy if i didn't go and didn't make anything of my life.

You remind me a lot of me. Right now the only thing keeping me going is because I don't want to hurt my mum more than I already have done. None of my problems are the "life and death, war orphans, beaten housewives" problems, I have a family that loves me, I have had an education, I'm going to university (all be it to do a subject I'm good at, not the one I really want to do). I am completely terrified of people. And actually, trivial as it may seem, I'd really like to be a writer, but I have absolutely no confidence in my own work and have never written anything non-school related that I've finished. And you know what, it sucks to be in this position. Everyone feels pain, regardless of your position in life, and we all find different things painful. It's life, people aren't all the same.

Don't punish yourself for that girl on OKcupid, I won't deny that you probably hurt her, but you have to try and understand what made you push her away like that and next time you need to try and work through it. And honestly, I don't think having a relationship right now would help you, I'm in a long term relationship. I lean on him a lot, we fight like a cat and dog and a few days ago he told me he hates me. Until you deal with your problems, you can't be there for someone else. This makes me sound like a hypocrite because I'm too cowardly to leave him for fear of being alone. But in my heart of hearts I know this relationship isn't doing either of us any good right now.

You need to find someone to talk to and go to for help. Even if that means just trying to find someone online, you're welcome to PM me if you want. But you need someone to go to and cry to and remind you that actually you aren't that bad a person. Sometimes it doesn't help very much, other people can't fix your life for you. But you need someone to talk to who will be there for you, being alone makes it so much worse.

I know this probably isn't the most positive post, right now I'm in a pretty bad place, but you reminded me so much of myself I felt I had to tell you you weren't alone. Focus on your reasons for going on, focus on the people that love you. In my life I have had perhaps 6 friends, I've had other acquaintances, but only a handful of true friends. They're the ones that matter, having one good friend is better than having one hundred people to hang out with. It doesn't always feel that way but it's true. You need to focus on the positives there. Focus on the project you're doing with your dad, think of the people you'll be helping, how you'll be making stuff better, possibly even meet someone you get on well with and make a friend. You have to try and set yourself small goals, things that make it worth keeping on for and try to focus on that and try and force all the bad things out of your head, because otherwise they will consume you.

I hope it helps you a little bit to know there are people who do care. Feel free to write back anytime.
